kebab_example: aliyun pds update-domain --domain-id bj1 --domain-name Hello_Enterprise_Drive --description Hello_enterprise_drive_debug_environment --init-drive-enable true --init-drive-size 1073741824 --user-count-quota 50 --size-quota 1099511627776 --published-app-access-strategy example-string --api-version 2022-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateDomain

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the default drive feature. A value of true specifies that all users are assigned a drive by default on the first logon. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否开通默认网盘。为true则所有用户在第一次登录后都默认分配一个网盘。默认false
parameters.name: init_drive_enable

parameters.help_en: The size of the default drive. Unit: bytes. You must specify init\_drive\_size if you set init\_drive\_enable to true. Default value: 0. A value of 0 specifies that the size of the default drive is 0 bytes and you cannot upload files to the drive. To initialize the default drive, set init\_drive\_size to 0. A value of -1 specifies that the size is unlimited
parameters.help_zh:
init\_drive\_enable 为true时必选。 创建用户时，默认网盘的大小，单位：Bytes。
默认为 0，此时创建的 drive 大小为0，不可以上传文件，如果需要初始化 drive， 请设置该值。
-1则表示不限大小
parameters.name: init_drive_size

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of users that can be created in the domain
parameters.name: user_count_quota

parameters.help_en: The total storage quota for all drives in the domain. A value of 0 specifies that the quota is unlimited
parameters.help_zh: 容量配额，表示 domain 下所有 drive 的总quota 大小，0 表示不限制
parameters.name: size_quota

fields.help_en:
The global access policy of the application. Valid values:

*   allow: The domain allows access from all applications.
*   deny: The domain denies access from all apps. This is the default value.

Recommended settings:

1.  Set effect to deny.
2.  Specify except_app_id_list to allow specific applications to access the domain. Example: \["appid1", "appid2"]
fields.help_zh:
全局 App 访问策略
* allow 表示允许所有 app 来访问该 domain
* deny 表示拒绝所有 app 来访问该 domain（默认）


建议配置：
1. 全局访问策略 effect 设置为 deny
2. 允许部分 app ID 来访问，设置 except_app_id_list 为 ["appid1", "appid2"]
fields.name: effect

fields.help_en:
The IDs of applications excluded from the global access policy.

*   If you set effect to allow, which indicates that the domain allows access from all applications, the applications specified by this parameter value cannot access the domain.
*   If you set effect to deny, which indicates that the domain denies access from all applications, the applications specified by this parameter value can access the domain
fields.help_zh:
例外的 app ID 列表

 * 当全局策略 effect 为 allow 时，表示全局允许所有的 app 来访问 domain，但是处于 except_app_id_list 列表的 app 则禁止访问 domain。
 * 当全局策略 effect 为 deny 时，表示全局禁止所有的 app 来访问 domain，但是处于 except_app_id_list 列表的 app 则允许访问 domain
fields.name: except_app_id_list

parameters.help_en: The access policy of the application
parameters.name: published_app_access_strategy
